name: ink-instrument
title: Ink Instrument
essence: Pale technical sheets, precise ink outlines and editorial scale changes; colour belongs to the specimen.
rules: Separate groups with whitespace and precise ink rules.
Keep controls neutral; colour lives inside photographs and diagrams.
Use one large editorial statement beside small structured labels.
Keep reading text readable; miniature reference captions are not a UI size specification.
Use outlined pressable controls, with solid ink identifying the selected segment.

decisions.emphasis: One oversized heading or isolated specimen surrounded by air.
decisions.primaryAction: The pale key on a solid ink edge: an outlined pill in condensed capitals that travels down onto its edge when pressed. One a screen.
decisions.secondaryAction: The same outlined pill on a thin ink edge, beside the main action and never competing with it.
decisions.destructiveAction: An outlined key that names what it removes, in words, and asks once before it happens. Never a colour.
decisions.currentPlace: Solid ink selected segment beside a hollow outlined segment.
decisions.status: A short word in condensed capitals beside a filled or hollow mark: filled is on, hollow is off. Never a colour alone.
decisions.typeRoles: Grotesque for body and headings; condensed capitals for short legends; monospaced figures for data.
decisions.layout: Technical sheet: stable grid, specimen area and aligned annotation bands.
decisions.surfaces: Pale sheets separated by ink outlines and whitespace.
decisions.colourJobs: Neutral ink for controls; specimen colour for identity and illustration.
decisions.iconography: Line icons in the ink at the outline's weight, hollow unless on, with a word beside any whose meaning isn't plain.
decisions.imagery: Sharp isolated objects, exploded views and technical diagrams.
decisions.copyVoice: Plain and exact, like a note on a technical sheet: short nouns for labels, and a key says its action in two or three words. Long sentences stay out of condensed capitals.
decisions.emptyStates: A pale sheet with one line saying what belongs there and one outlined key to add it. No illustration stands in for the words.

motion.character: Short, damped presses and exact transitions; no decorative overshoot. Reduced motion removes travel.

sound.voice: Dry quiet ticks, muted until enabled.
